label: Test: spawn 20 ships
description: Spawns 20 player-owned scouts (Twitch 2..21) next to the player.

label: Balance
description: Shows your coin balance and karma in chat.

label: Karma
description: Explains karma and shows yours.

label: Shop
description: Lists what you can buy (this page).

label: Sectors
description: Explains how to aim a station at a sector, and looks a sector name up (e.g. !sectors grand).

label: Name a ship
description: Rename one of the player's ships.

label: Adopt a ship
description: Claim one of the player's existing ships as yours — it gets renamed after you. Price scales with the hull: `!buy adopt` lists what's available with ID codes and prices, then `!buy adopt PSF-481`. ONE ship per viewer — !abandon yours before taking another. `!fleet` shows the list, `!myship` shows yours.

label: Fleet
description: Lists the player's ships that are still up for adoption, with their ID codes and prices. Add a hull class to narrow it down: !fleet S (or M, L, XL) — handy when the cheapest ships crowd out the capitals.

label: My ship
description: Shows which ship(s) you have adopted.

label: Abandon a ship
description: Give up a ship you adopted: it goes back on the !fleet list and the game reverts its name. !abandon on its own if you hold one ship, !abandon <ID> otherwise. Free, and the coins you paid are not refunded.

label: Resurrect a ship
description: Rebuild one of your adopted ships after it is destroyed. A replacement hull of the same type is laid down at the player's HQ and renamed back to you. Costs 1.5x what adopting that hull costs; wrecks keep indefinitely, so there is no rush.

label: Spawn Raiders
description: Summon a squad of hostile Twitch Raiders (the twitchfoe faction) that hunt the player.

label: Pirate harassment
description: One S/M pirate jumps in to annoy the nearest player ship.

label: Gift wares
description: Drop wares near the player; price scales with qty.

label: Gift a ship
description: Buy the player a ship (e.g. !buy ship nemesis, !buy ship katana). Price scales with the ship; '!buy ship' lists what's available. Spawns player-owned beside the player with a random loadout.

label: Kha'ak swarm
description: A cluster of Kha'ak fighters jumps in and attacks.

label: Tracker Mines
description: Seed six hostile Tracker Mines around the player. They wake up, home in and detonate — shoot them or outrun them (they give up past 1.5km). Anything left over self-destructs in 10 minutes.

label: Terran Task Force
description: An ATF battle group jumps in on the player's side: an Asgard, 2 Syn, 2 Osaka and 17 escorts, already hunting whatever the player is at war with. Built to beat the Xenon Armada. Survivors stay in the game. Needs the Cradle of Humanity DLC.

label: Xenon K
description: A Xenon K destroyer jumps into the player's sector.

label: Xenon Armada
description: A Xenon I and 21 escorts jump in on the player and attack as one fleet. Nothing cleans them up afterwards — whatever survives stays in the game. CRISIS LEVEL: only buyable while the streamer has accepted crisis level in the companion.

label: Spawn Allies
description: Summon a friendly Twitch Allies squad that joins your fleet (or patrols the sector). Also auto-fires on a raid.

label: NPC Faction Incident
description: Sour relations between two NPC factions (uses the game's diplomacy system). Omit for two random, or name one or two of: argon, antigone, hatikvah, teladi, ministry, paranid, holyorder, trinity, alliance, terran, pioneers, boron, split, freesplit, twitchally. Short names work too (hop, zya, tel...). E.g. !buy incident argon paranid

label: Twitch Faction Stance
description: Set the Twitch Allies' standing with one NPC faction to ally, neutral or war — the game's own relation bands, so it really does make them shoot (or stop shooting). E.g. !buy stance paranid war, !buy stance teladi ally. Targets: argon, antigone, hatikvah, teladi, ministry, paranid, holyorder, trinity, alliance, terran, pioneers, boron, split, freesplit.

label: Defence Platform
description: Build a fully armed defence platform. Goes to the Twitch Allies unless you end the line with `player`. E.g. !buy defence, !buy defence argon prime, !buy defence player.

label: Solar Power Plant
description: Build a working energy-cell factory, stocked and staffed. E.g. !buy solar, or !buy solar black hole sun iv. Built for the Twitch Allies; add `player` to the line to give it to the player instead.

label: Trading Station
description: Build a trading station. E.g. !buy tradestation, or !buy tradestation antigone memorial. Built for the Twitch Allies; add `player` to the line to give it to the player instead.

label: Equipment Dock
description: Build an equipment dock for refits and repairs. E.g. !buy equipmentdock argon prime. Built for the Twitch Allies; add `player` to the line to give it to the player instead.

label: Wharf
description: Build a wharf (S/M ship construction). E.g. !buy wharf, or !buy wharf grand exchange iv. Built for the Twitch Allies; add `player` to the line to give it to the player instead.

label: Shipyard
description: Build a shipyard (L/XL ship construction) — the biggest gift in the shop. E.g. !buy shipyard. Built for the Twitch Allies; add `player` to the line to give it to the player instead.

label: Raider Den
description: Plant a hostile Twitch Raider base (the twitchfoe faction) in a sector. E.g. !buy piratebase argon prime.

label: Kha'ak Hive
description: Plant a Kha'ak hive in a sector. It stays. E.g. !buy hive, or !buy hive second contact ii flashpoint.

label: Disarm a station
description: Shut down every turret AND the defence drones on the station closest to the player for 10 minutes, then they come back online. Same window the base game gives a hacked turret panel. Works on anyone's station — including the player's.

label: Hack a station
description: Hack the storage module on the station closest to the player — the same trick pirates use to plunder one. Its cargo bursts out as containers for anyone to scoop up.

label: Vision
description: Deploy a ring of advanced satellites around the player's current sector.
